title: Segment Routing page + VRF L3VPN workflow
acceptance_criteria: Backend exposes /vyos/segment-routing capabilities/config/batch with strict command scope validation.
Routing UI includes dedicated Segment Routing page with OSPF/IS-IS SR block and Prefix-SID management.
VRF page includes dedicated L3VPN workflow for RD/RT/label/route-leaking/route-map controls and BGP MPLS forwarding interfaces.
Left navigation is consolidated to a single VRF item; L3VPN is represented as an in-page tab.
Strict backlog tasks PR-03 and VRF-02 are moved out of missing status.
Backend tests and frontend typecheck/lint/build/runtime smoke pass.
assumptions: L3VPN workflow models high-value documented leaves first; advanced live interop validation remains in partial backlog.
Playwright browser smoke remains environment-blocked until libnspr4.so is installed on host.

tasks.notes: Mapped Segment Routing and VRF L3VPN command trees from docs.vyos.io and aligned slice scope.
Added thin segment-routing router and command scope tests.
Built form-first Segment Routing editor and integrated in routing infrastructure pages.
Extended VRF model and UI for L3VPN workflows; consolidated navigation to a single VRF item.
Added segment-routing and vrf-l3vpn routes to smoke probes; runtime smoke passes.
Manual in-process review complete for regression/contract checks; follow-up deep live validation remains.
